GRAIN
We value the relationship we have with grain producers and elevators in our trade area. You are extremely important to our facility as we process nearly 26 million bushels of corn and milo per year.

Grain Receiving:
Call: 620-694-5410 Our grain receiving personnel communicate with trucks that have a CB on channel #14. If a truck does not have a CB, they can call the Scale House at 620-694-5410.
Normal Grain Receiving Hours :
Monday - Friday
7:30 a.m. - 4:00 p.m.
Harvest Hours will be posted on the Cash Bids page.
Trucking Information
Our grain receiving personnel communicate with trucks that have a CB on channel #14. If a truck does not have a CB, they can call the Scale House at 620-694-5410.
In compliance with FDA Regulation 21CFR 589.2000, haulers of bulk feed ingredients including grain into this facility need to verify that the non-prohibited commodities being delivered or loaded from our facility have not been contaminated with prohibited animal proteins during transport. To provide the necessary verification, signing your bill of lading indicates that you are confirming the
following:
1. The last ingredient hauled contained no prohibited mammalian protein.
OR
2. If the last ingredient hauled was a prohibited animal product, the following physical procedures were performed including sweeping, vacuuming, use of compressed air, washing, or flushing with a sufficient volume of non-prohibited material to prevent the carry-over of prohibited animal protein into the present commodity. If a prohibited material on the below list was the previously hauled material, a wash out ticket must be presented. The following ingredients are identified as Prohibited Material by AAFCO:
Bone Meal, Steamed
Dehydrated Food Waste
Meat Dried
Meat Solubles
Meat and Bone Meal
Meat and Bone Meal Tankage
Unborn Calf Carcasses
Leather Hydrolysate
Livestock
Mechanically Separated Bone Marrow
Animal Liver
Meat Meal
Animal Digest
Bone Meal, Cooked
Dehydrated Garbage
Fleshings Hydrolysate
Hydrolyzed Hair
Animal By-Product Meal
If the below ingredients are the previous hauled material, the trailer is required to be at a minimum swept/broomed out prior to hauling any commodity intended for cattle consumption.
Fertilizer
Rock
Lime
Fly Ash
Economizer Ash
Salt
Kansas Ethanol, LLC certifies that our operations are in compliance with all applicable provisions of FDA Regulation 21 CFR 589.2000. We further certify that this form will cover all future shipments until we provide written notification that this form is no longer in effect.
